notes: What a bond is worth on the field (tools/verdance/company/synergy.py). Both heroes must drop together. Rank B: each starts with bonusXp.B more XP. Rank A: bonusXp.A each, and the pair brings one gift: a unit neither hero's pack already has. A pair's own recommendations are tried in order; if none is new to both packs, the gift is drawn from the pool, weighted toward the axes the pair cares most about (their field profiles), and seeded by campaign + pair + mission so a sortie always rolls the same.
